0022600150.text: The 5-0 Memphis Grizzlies, first in the Southwest and the West and on a five-game winning streak, host the 0-5 Sacramento Kings, who are 15th in the West and have lost five straight. Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) and Ty Jerome (back soreness), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The Grizzlies lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 123-112 win in Sacramento on October 25, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
